tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List the tools on the connected MCP servers. THESE SERVERS ARE AVAILABLE AND YOU SHOULD USE THEM RATHER THAN GUESSING OR WORKING AROUND THEM: fs (read_file, write_file). Call this FIRST, then call_tool. With a keyword, search_capabilities is cheaper. Read-only. Returns a line per tool, else per server with any error.
tools.title: List server tools

tools.name: describe_tool
tools.description: Get the arguments of ONE backend tool, before call_tool. `server`/`tool` are catalogue names; an unknown one returns the valid ones. Read-only. Returns each argument and its type.
tools.title: Describe a tool

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Invoke a tool on a connected server. THIS IS THE STEP THAT ANSWERS THE USER -- list_capabilities only finds the name. `server`/`tool` are catalogue names. Side effects are the backend tool's own. Returns its result as text, big ones via retrieve_spill.

args.description: Object or JSON string; omit if none.

tools.title: Call a backend tool

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Find a tool by keyword on every connected server; cheaper than list_capabilities when you know roughly what you want. Read-only. Returns a line per match, best first, with args.
tools.title: Search tools

tools.name: list_groups_with_costs
tools.description: Tool GROUPS with the context-token cost of loading each; to find a tool use list_capabilities. Read-only. Returns a line per group and the totals.
tools.title: List tool groups and costs

tools.name: retrieve_spill
tools.description: Read back the FULL original of a result call_tool shortened, by the id in its notice; an unknown or pruned id fails saying so. Read-only. Returns a text window, or grep's lines.
tools.title: Read an archived result
